findings.summary: The exported array registry duplicates the object registry without a production consumer.
findings.consequence: This keeps a second public registry shape alive even though production code uses SLA_ARTICLE_REGISTRY_BY_ID and isSlaArticleId directly, so future article registry changes must preserve an extra API that currently only supports tests.
findings.evidence: The owned map at lines 39-42 derives SLA_ARTICLE_REGISTRY entirely from SLA_ARTICLE_REGISTRY_BY_ID. Repository search found no production imports of SLA_ARTICLE_REGISTRY; only test/unit/sla-article-fixtures.spec.ts imports it for fixture assertions and cross-link set construction. Direct production consumers inspected use SLA_ARTICLE_REGISTRY_BY_ID or isSlaArticleId.
findings.recommendation: Delete the exported SLA_ARTICLE_REGISTRY and have the fixture test derive the ordered entries locally from Object.entries(SLA_ARTICLE_REGISTRY_BY_ID). If a production list is later needed, introduce it at the consumer rather than maintaining a second shared public registry shape now.
